subject: Night Passage Root Sepulcher environment
review: Inspected native assembly, pillar and lantern in clay and materials. Corrected camera far clipping and view framing; no native geometry repair was needed.
Broad slabs and pale boundary coping define a quiet combat floor. Tomb markers, rooted columns and bronze lanterns establish the first region kit.

Inspected all four controlled production layouts and matched native/fallback warning views at 960x600 and selected 390x244 views. Foreground stays low, all pillar materials fade for windups and warnings remain visible.
Pale caps and boundaries carry the arena silhouette at narrow scale. Fine root and bronze details recede. Higher detail is future polish.

geometryAgreement.sampling: Every native evaluated vertex and every delivered vertex, with symmetric nearest-surface-vertex matching for export splits.

savedEditProof.edit: Raise saved Pillar_cap top by four game units, save/reload/export

limits: One of four environment kits is authored. Three region kits and further effects/icons remain queued.
Static source agreement and passing gates do not establish user art approval or measured frame-time improvement.
Low-detail stone and root forms retain scope for sculpted wear, branch detail and textures.

delegation.ownership: Primary authored native source/export, docs, integration and visual review; reused workers owned runtime/unit tests and browser/static delivery checks.
delegation.rework: Review camera framing repaired by primary; static test cleanup types corrected before full gate. Delegated runtime and all three browser journeys passed integration.
delegation.efficiency: Both delegated outputs used. No measured single-agent timing comparison.
